Barnaby trotted out into the back yard.
The morning lawn felt cool and wet.
Tiny water drops sat on the blades.
Barnaby put his nose to the dirt.
Barnaby smelled a pink worm under the dirt.
The worm wiggled through the dirt.
The worm pushed small air holes into the dirt.
Barnaby walked over to the tall oak tree.
Pip sat on a high branch.
Pip held a brown acorn in his paws.
Pip scampered to the trunk along the branch.
Pip ran to the dirt down the trunk.
Pip dug a small hole in the dirt.
Pip pushed the acorn into the dirt.
Pip covered the small hole with three dead leaves.
Barnaby watched Pip hide the acorn.
Pip ran to the branch up the trunk.
A yellow bee landed on a purple flower.
The bee drank sweet nectar from the flower.
Yellow pollen dust stuck to the bee's legs.
The bee flew to another purple flower.
Barnaby lay down in the warm sunlight.
Barnaby twitched his big ears at the buzzing.
Barnaby closed his eyes.
Barnaby rested his paws.
